description.text: Objectives This program focuses on comparison on language as well as cultural aspects between Chinese and English including etiquettes, legal systems, ethics, and academic writing skills. The program is designed for professionals who wish to work and succeed in various government agencies, educational institutions, and businesses. Candidates will develop high levels of language proficiency and keen intercultural sensitivity. Duration Duration of the program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Cross-cultural Studies 2. English Language Teaching Methodology 3. Sino-western Cross-cultural Communication and Integration 4. Academic Writing Skills and Academic Ethics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete 38 credits including 20 for required courses, 12 for elective courses, and 3 credits for seminars, reports and interim assessment.

duration.text: The Comparative Study between Chinese and Western Cultures at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree 4) Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 5) Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) 6) Two letters of recommendation from two associate professors or higher

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Under the age of 35. 4. Have attained a Bachelor's diploma with good marks. 5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
